interpretations: Among accounts with at least one order, calculate each account’s order count divided by the total order count. Select accounts whose share exceeds the mean share across those accounts. Return one unrounded row containing the selected accounts’ combined order count, their mean share, and their mean share minus the mean share across all accounts with orders
queries:
WITH account_orders AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
),
shares AS (
    SELECT order_count,
           1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM account_orders
),
mean_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS value
    FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(s.order_count),
       AVG(s.share),
       AVG(s.share) - m.value
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN mean_share AS m
WHERE s.share > m.value
